name: fseval
description: The fseval Python package allows benchmarking Feature Selection and Feature Ranking algorithms on a large scale, and facilitates the comparison of multiple algorithms in a systematic way. In particular, fseval enables users to run experiments in parallel and distributed over multiple machines, and export the results to an SQL database. The execution of an experiment can be fully determined by a configuration file, which means the experiment results can be reproduced easily, given only the configuration file. fseval has high test coverage, continuous integration, and rich documentation. The package is open source and can be installed through PyPI. The source code is available at: https://github.com/dunnkers/fseval.
evaluation_method: multi-metric: downstream model performance (e.g., accuracy, AUC) and ranking metrics (e.g., NDCG, precision@k)
general_score_metric: Depends on experiment; commonly downstream accuracy/AUC and ranking metrics such as NDCG or precision@k
reputation: Open-source Python package with modest adoption among researchers and practitioners working on feature selection and ranking experiments.
notes: Non-LLM benchmarking tool focused on classical ML feature selection; reproducible and configurable but outcomes depend on chosen downstream tasks and metrics; large-scale experiments can be compute-intensive.
